summary: State Street Corporation filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an underwritten public offering of fixed-to-floating rate senior notes due 2032 and 2037. The aggregate principal amounts, fixed rates, floating spreads, and final terms are to be determined. The notes are unsecured, rank equally with other senior unsecured debt, are not FDIC-insured, and are not listed on any exchange. Joint book-running managers are Morgan Stanley, Deutsche Bank Securities, Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC, and UBS Investment Bank. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. No special-situation dynamics apply.
